summary: UCSF lists a 'Community Center Garage' at 1625 Owens Street among its Mission Bay campus parking options, and DataSF's official address point for 1625 Owens St lies inside this record's outline. No source read says when, by whom or how it was built; the May 2000 Regents item for the neighbouring community center says an interim parking lot would be built beside it 'until a parking structure can be built in a later phase'.

milestones.text: UC Regents Committee on Grounds and Buildings item (May 17, 2000) for the Mission Bay community center building says an 'interim parking lot will be developed at the northwest corner of the building until a parking structure can be built in a later phase of campus development'; the item is about the community center, not the garage

facts.value: Parking: UCSF lists it among its Mission Bay campus parking options; the page is undated

DataSF's official address point for 1625 Owens St (address ID 731845, parcel 8709011) lies inside this record's outline, 16.7 m from its nearest edge (Pier & Point's own calculation in a local metric projection). The Assessor lists one parcel, 8709011 ('1675 1625 Owens'), for the community center and the garage together, so the point places the address here but does not tell the garage apart from the center.

open_questions: When was the Community Center Garage built, and is it a multi-level structure? UCSF's parking page (undated) offers parking at 1625 Owens St, and the city's address point is inside the outline, but no source read dates its construction or opening.

STRUCTURE QUESTION: the May 2000 Regents item describes an interim parking lot beside the community center, to be replaced by a parking structure in a later phase. In UCSF's June 12, 2025 Mission Bay CAC figure (an image) the label 'COMMUNITY CENTER GARAGE (21A)' sits beside a flat, building-less parcel with a parking symbol, where it was viewed by eye, not as text. Whether a parking structure was ever built here, or the 'garage' is the surface lot, is not established. The geometry file's rooftop-deck reading comes from the project's own satellite review and is not corroborated by a document.

The Assessor's 2022 roll has one parcel (8709011, listed '1675 1625 OWENS') for the community center and the garage together, with no year built; a DBI permit search on block 8709 lot 011 returned only two unrelated permits (a street-space permit and a 2021 telecommunications-equipment alteration), so no new-construction permit for a garage was found.
Architect, builder, space count and operator are not found. UCSF's Parking and Transportation pages were not opened (blocked).
The garage is distinct from the 1670 Owens garage (DBI permit 200801243180, 823 spaces), which has its own record.
No UC Regents capital item for a community-center garage was located.
